title: Number of Childcare Operators under Partner Operator Scheme
what_it_is: Number of Childcare Operators under Partner Operator Scheme

sections.label: Childcare POP scheme operators
sections.summary: Over 30 operators applied, 23 were appointed in October 2015, running 169 POP centres with 16,500 places and fee and quality requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Over 30 childcare operators applied for the POP scheme through an open and competitive process.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Out of these applicants, 23 were appointed in October 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Together, they run 169 POP centres offering a total of 16,500 places.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Besides the one-time fee reduction from January 2016, POP centres are also required to keep fees affordable and meet certain quality targets in the next few years.
